name: X-COM: Enforcer
description: X-COM: Enforcer is a singleplayer and multiplayer third-person shooter game and a spin-off in the X-COM series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: X-COM: Enforcer only plays EAX reverb when its hardware 3D sound and spatial sound options are on.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: X-COM: Enforcer mixes its sound at a low sample rate, which dulls high-pitched sounds.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: X-COM: Enforcer filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: X-COM: Enforcer runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.
